description: Liste des arrêtés permanents de voirie - Ville de Lorient is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Lorient. Location of permanent road by-laws issued by the City of Lorient road service. This is a direct, daily extraction of data from the roadside arrest management software. Coverage: Ville de Lorient. The portal shows the English title as "List of permanent road by-laws - City of Lorient" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Lorient. Its keywords include reglementation, ville-de-lorient, lorient, arrete, voirie. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
